verdict.rationale: The README directly offers prebuilt binaries from the GitHub releases page, Docker images, a Winget listing, and the llama.app install route as alternatives to building from source. A community user confirms running the official release binaries on macOS, though they first had to clear the quarantine attribute. Missing for 10: detailed package-manager coverage beyond a bare Winget heading (e.g. Homebrew or Linux packages), and smoother macOS binary install without manual xattr quarantine removal.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: Run with Docker - see our [Docker documentation](docs/docker.md)
Visit https://llama.app and follow the instructions
